description: This file is a Python script implementing a Gerrit REST API client library, including functions for querying, reviewing, submitting, and managing Gerrit change lists, as well as command-line interface handling.

classes.name: CompletedProcess
classes.description: Represents the result of a subprocess.run() execution, including args, returncode, stdout, and stderr.

classes.name: CurlSocket
classes.description: A mock socket object that loads the response from a curl output file.

classes.name: CurlHTTPHandler
classes.description: A custom HTTPHandler that uses curl to send HTTP requests.

classes.name: CurlHTTPSHandler
classes.description: A custom HTTPSHandler that uses curl to send HTTPS requests.

methods.name: _build_curl_command_for_request
methods.description: Constructs a curl command line for an HTTP/HTTPS request.

methods.name: _handle_open_with_curl
methods.description: Executes a curl command to perform an HTTP request and returns a response object.

methods.name: load_auth_credentials_from_file
methods.description: Loads credentials from an opened .gitcookies file.

methods.name: load_auth_credentials
methods.description: Loads credentials from a .gitcookies file given its path.

methods.name: _domain_matches
methods.description: Checks if a domain name matches a domain pattern according to RFC 6265.

methods.name: _find_auth_credentials
methods.description: Finds login credentials matching a domain.

methods.name: create_url_opener
methods.description: Creates a URL opener with authentication credentials loaded from a .gitcookies file.

methods.name: create_url_opener_from_args
methods.description: Creates a URL opener based on command line arguments, optionally using curl.

methods.name: _decode_xssi_json
methods.description: Removes XSSI prefix and decodes JSON data.

methods.name: _query_change_lists
methods.description: Performs a single Gerrit change list query request.

methods.name: query_change_lists
methods.description: Performs multiple Gerrit change list queries to gather results.

methods.name: _make_json_post_request
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request and decodes the response.

methods.name: set_review
methods.description: Sets review labels on a Gerrit change.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a Gerrit change.

methods.name: abandon
methods.description: Abandons a Gerrit change.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a Gerrit change.

methods.name: set_topic
methods.description: Sets the topic of a Gerrit change.

methods.name: delete_topic
methods.description: Deletes the topic of a Gerrit change.

methods.name: set_hashtags
methods.description: Adds or removes hashtags on a Gerrit change.

methods.name: add_reviewers
methods.description: Adds reviewers to a Gerrit change.

methods.name: delete_reviewer
methods.description: Removes a reviewer from a Gerrit change.

methods.name: get_patch
methods.description: Downloads the patch file for a Gerrit change revision.

methods.name: find_gerrit_name
methods.description: Finds the Gerrit instance URL from the repo manifest.

methods.name: normalize_gerrit_name
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from Gerrit URL.

methods.name: add_common_parse_args
methods.description: Adds common command-line arguments for Gerrit operations.

methods.name: _parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the script, performs Gerrit change list queries and outputs results.
